Hi Sophie / Tom — quick update from engineering ops. Apologies for the delay, wanted to give you a clean fix.

What happened (root cause): when the organizer forwarded the invite via Outlook the original ICS used an ATTACH with the Zoom payload. Outlook's forward flow strips ATTACH fields for security, so GCal never got the join button.

What we did:
1) Generated regen_acme_invite_v2.ics and attached it to this message. It contains:
   - DESCRIPTION: includes the full Zoom join URL and dial-in lines
   - X-ALT-LINK: custom property with the same join URL (most GCal clients check this before ATTACH)
   - ORGANIZER set to redwood-organizer@redwood.com (optional) so resends aren't forwarded from a personal alias.
2) Also included a plain text file (joinlink_temp_zoom.txt) with the temporary Zoom link (same as Karthik shared).

Quick steps for Acme to get the working join button:
- I recommend we resend the attached regen_acme_invite_v2.ics from redwood-organizer@redwood.com to the list of attendees.
- If your organizer is forwarding invites from Outlook, ask them to forward the regenerated ICS as an attachment rather than inline.

I've validated by doing a test forward (Outlook -> Gmail) and confirmed the GCal UI shows a "Join" button for the event using the X-ALT-LINK property.

Attachments: regen_acme_invite_v2.ics, joinlink_temp_zoom.txt
Please confirm you received the attachments and whether you'd like us to resend the invite from redwood-organizer@redwood.com on your behalf.

Thanks,
